note.zh: 游牧民族且拥有驿站时在驿站所在系统（1817），否则在境内随机系统（1816）。
note.en: Nomads with a waystation get it at the waystation system (1817), otherwise a random system inside the borders (1816).

notes.zh: 隐藏事件 cstorms.1810 在首次遭遇风暴时（on_storm_encountered，00_on_actions.txt:5509）排程，1800天后 cstorms.1815 选地点。注意 1810 设置的是 triggered_eye_of_the_storm 而不是 triggered_storm_in_a_box（cosmic_storms_events_1.txt:4024），所以“只触发一次”的保护可能并未生效；未实测，存疑。
notes.en: Hidden cstorms.1810 is scheduled on the first storm encounter (on_storm_encountered, 00_on_actions.txt:5509); 1800 days later cstorms.1815 picks the place. Note 1810 sets triggered_eye_of_the_storm rather than triggered_storm_in_a_box (cosmic_storms_events_1.txt:4024), so the once-only guard may not work; untested, uncertain.

scope.zh: 已对照游戏文件核对入口与触发、条件、选项与结果、分类，并撰写双语导读。
scope.en: Root and trigger, conditions, options and outcomes, and category checked against the game files; bilingual guide written.

uncertain: cstorms.1810 sets triggered_eye_of_the_storm instead of triggered_storm_in_a_box (L4024); not tested whether it can fire repeatedly.
